data_tier_basis: US SEC filer, CIK 50863: dual-source price plane (price_status AGREED, both legs printing 89.47 on 2026-08-28), SEC companyfacts fundamentals with coverage 19 of 20 annual fields (total_liabilities missing), and a SCORED quality block in data/market/INTC.json with Piotroski and Beneish both computed on full inputs.
opportunity_tier_basis: COMPLETE profiles are O2 until run selection promotes them (method section 6A). Selection is a separate command and was not run here. Four canonical fields are NULL on this profile, and O1 forbids a NULL canonical field, so this issuer cannot be promoted while they stand.

identity_evidence_ref.source_name: SEC EDGAR company-submissions current entity metadata

placements.role: Provides EMIB 2.5D and Foveros 3D packaging for AI and high-performance-computing systems.

role_evidence.claim: Intel Foundry says its advanced-packaging portfolio includes EMIB-T for future high-bandwidth-memory needs and Foveros Direct 3D hybrid bonding.

placements.role: Designs Gaudi accelerators for data-center AI training and inference.

role_evidence.claim: Current AI-chip research identifies Intel's Gaudi product line as a data-center AI accelerator.

business_summary: Intel Corporation is a NASDAQ-listed integrated device manufacturer that designs and fabricates its own silicon and, since the foundry separation, sells manufacturing and advanced packaging to third parties. For this chain it is two different businesses: a packaging supplier through EMIB and Foveros, and an accelerator vendor through Gaudi. It is also the only issuer in this batch that is currently loss-making at the operating line.

exposure_summary.narrative: Two placements of unequal strength. advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) is backed by Intel Foundry's own dated release describing EMIB-T and Foveros Direct 3D hybrid bonding, and is the placement that matters here. ai-accelerators (position 9, heat OVER_CROWDED at crowdedness 92) rests on the Gaudi line and is the weakest evidence in this batch: the mapping tags that placement INFERRED from third-party AI-chip research rather than VERIFIED from an issuer source, which is a materially weaker basis than every other placement carried here.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Intel reports an Intel Foundry segment but does not break out advanced packaging or AI accelerator revenue within it, so no disclosed percentage of revenue attributable to either placement exists in a source read this run.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INTC.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-27 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INTC.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (52853000000 / 63054000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-27. Revenue has declined in each of the last three fiscal years.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INTC.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss -2214000000 divided by Revenues 52853000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-27, both from companyfacts. The margin is negative: Intel lost money at the operating line in fiscal 2025, an improvement on the -11678000000 operating loss of fiscal 2024.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: operating cash flow to net income is not a meaningful ratio for Intel in fiscal 2025: net income is -267000000, so operating cash flow 9697000000 divided by it returns -36.3, a number whose sign and magnitude describe the loss rather than the conversion. The inputs are both present and sourced; the ratio is withheld because it would mislead, and fcf_margin carries this group instead.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INTC.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 9697000000 less capital expenditure 14646000000, divided by revenue 52853000000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-27 from companyfacts. It is negative: Intel spent 4949000000 more on capital than it generated from operations.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed for Intel. The numerator is available and sourced, net debt 35675000000 (total debt 48549000000 less cash 12874000000, both as of 2026-06-27), but the denominator is not: the companyfacts depreciation series in data/market/INTC.json ends at fiscal 2019-12-28 with a value of 200000000 that is inconsistent with Intel's scale, so no fiscal 2025 depreciation and amortisation figure exists to build an EBITDA proxy on, and fiscal 2025 operating income is negative in any case.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/INTC.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 6 (state MIDDLING) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/INTC.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found. Operating cash flow, change in return on assets, accruals, change in leverage, current ratio and gross margin all pass; return on assets, share count and asset turnover fail. Six of nine on a loss-making year is the score of a business improving from a low base, not a healthy one.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/INTC.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.758 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/INTC.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 446813180000 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 4994000000 as of 2025-12-27 multiplied by the close 89.47 of 2026-08-28. The share count is the official SEC figure; the close is the repo's own dual-source market plane (data/market/INTC.json, price_status AGREED), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/INTC.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 446813180000 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-27 revenue 52853000000. The share count is official SEC companyfacts; the close 89.47 of 2026-08-28 is the repo's own market plane, not an issuer document.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/INTC.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 482488180000 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-27 revenue 52853000000. Enterprise value exceeds market capitalization because net debt is 35675000000.

price_to_earnings.basis: price-to-earnings is not defined for Intel in fiscal 2025: GAAP net income is -267000000, so the ratio against a market capitalization of 446813180000 would be a negative number with no interpretation. Price to sales and enterprise value to sales carry the valuation group instead.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: reverse-DCF implied FCF CAGR cannot be solved for Intel: data/market/INTC.json quality.reverse_dcf reports state NOT_APPLICABLE with the reason that base-year free cash flow is not positive. Free cash flow for fiscal 2025 is -4949000000, and a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless. This is a determinate finding about the issuer, not a missing fetch.

horizon_spread.basis: reverse-DCF horizon spread cannot be computed for Intel because the base implied FCF CAGR solve is NOT_APPLICABLE on negative free cash flow, so there is no set of per-horizon solves to take a spread across.

crowdedness_caveats: data/market/INTC.json carries no pcs block, so analyst count and institutional ownership were not measured for this issuer this run.

The ai-accelerators link is the most crowded in the whole chain: crowdedness 92, capture 90, verdict OVER_CROWDED (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json). Intel's placement on it is also the weakest-evidenced placement in this batch.
The 52-week range is 24.00 to 140.94 against an 89.47 close. The stock has moved nearly six-fold off its low inside a year, which is a repriced position rather than an overlooked one.

Price to sales of 8.5 on a business with three consecutive years of declining revenue and a negative operating margin is the crowdedness reading that matters here: the multiple is being paid for the foundry and packaging turnaround, not for the current income statement.

catalysts.claim: Intel's own second-quarter 2026 release reports revenue of 16.1 billion dollars, up 25% year over year, with Intel Foundry revenue of 5.8 billion dollars up 31%. The chief executive names advanced packaging explicitly as one of the franchises the company expects to capture growth across.
catalysts.source_excerpt: AI is driving unprecedented demand for compute, and as we continue to execute, Intel is well-positioned to capture sustainable growth across our CPU franchise, ASICs, advanced packaging and vast wafer foundry network.

catalysts.claim: Intel Foundry's own dated release establishes EMIB-T for future high-bandwidth-memory needs and Foveros Direct 3D hybrid bonding, which is the technical basis of the advanced-packaging placement.

risks.claim: The same second-quarter 2026 release records an Intel Foundry operating loss of 2.089 billion dollars on that 5.8 billion dollars of revenue. The segment this chain cares about grows and loses money at the same time.

Free cash flow was -4949000000 in fiscal 2025 and the three-year revenue CAGR is -5.7%. The reverse DCF cannot even be posed against a negative base, so there is no expectations reading to test the price against.
risks.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INTC.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

risks.claim: The ai-accelerators placement is INFERRED from third-party AI-chip research rather than from an issuer source, and sits on the chain's most crowded link. It should not be treated as equivalent to the packaging placement.

data_gaps: Four canonical fields are NULL: operating_cash_flow_to_net_income, net_debt_to_ebitda, price_to_earnings and both reverse_dcf fields. Each names its own cause in its basis, and all but one are determinate findings about a loss-making year rather than missing data.

The one genuine data gap is the EBITDA denominator: the companyfacts depreciation series in data/market/INTC.json ends at fiscal 2019-12-28 with a value inconsistent with Intel's scale, which is a concept-mapping gap in the fetch plane and is captured to the backlog. companyfacts coverage also misses total_liabilities, which is not a canonical profile field.
No advanced-packaging or accelerator revenue split is disclosed within the Intel Foundry segment, so the share of revenue attributable to either placement is unknown.

data/edgar/docs/INTC.json does not exist, so no filing document was available locally to verify a quote against. The second-quarter 2026 excerpt above was fetched directly from the issuer's own investor-relations release this run and is reproduced verbatim from it.

Completion rule applied uniformly across this batch: a profile is COMPLETE when revenue, growth, margins, cash conversion and valuation all resolve to sourced numbers AND the earnings-quality state can be established. A profile whose earnings-quality state cannot be established, or which has no fundamentals at all, is BLOCKED. Individual NULL fields are permitted on a COMPLETE profile where the input is genuinely absent or the computation is not meaningful, and each such NULL blocks O1 promotion on its own.

disposition.basis: The packaging placement is real and issuer-sourced, and the earnings-quality state is established and clean. Deferred because the valuation case cannot be posed on this record: negative operating margin, negative free cash flow, a three-year revenue decline and no reverse-DCF solve to test 8.5 times sales against. Deferred is a statement about what is measurable, not a verdict; selection is a separate command that was not run.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is computed from SEC companyfacts with the derivation named in its basis; where a market price enters the computation the basis says so. There is no SPECULATIVE figure because the reverse-DCF solve is not applicable on negative base free cash flow. NULL is a field looked for and not found or not meaningful, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
